decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the selected 74AHCT1G125 LCSC part in the BOM state, with no obsolete candidate key requiring removal.
Selecting the LED data level shifter does not change the separate requirement to disable the shared 5V rail through GPIO5 for zero standby current.
The source changes the supply and data-interface logic for the SK6812 LEDs, not the separate board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The rail state already includes SK6812 LEDs as 5V loads; the source confirms that arrangement but does not change the rail voltage, load inventory, switching behavior, or control GPIO.
The LED supply and level-shifter selection does not alter any sensor-board connector, pinout, module, or sensor supply requirement.
The source does not change any interboard connector type, pinout, board-chain topology, or power-distribution interface.
The 5V LED supply and data level shifter are independent of the standalone USB 3.3V regulator, its capacity, and its source-selection behavior.
The monitoring requirement already measures the 5V rail containing the LEDs; changing the LED data-level-shifter part does not alter the measured rails, monitor IC, channels, or monitor placement.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery/USB path, VMID and VSYS topology, or the normal 3.3V power source.
Naming an LCSC part for the level shifter does not modify the existing general sourceability policy or the interboard-connector sourcing strategy, and the source makes no availability claim.
The LED electrical-interface decision does not affect battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The level-shifter replacement and confirmed LED voltage do not entail any change to board dimensions, mounting holes, USB-C position, aspect ratio, or enclosure fit.
